title: Addon for Keep Some Inventory - End Remastered
description: Add support for End Remastered to Keep Some Inventory.
body:
Drop your modded End Remastered items on death!

"Keep Some Inventory" by PuckiSilver allows you to keep certain items on death. "End Remastered" by jack-bagel adds many items to your game.

This addon is for people who want any new items to drop on death when you are using both of these mods together. This addon configures it so all End Remastered items are dropped on death. If you want anything to be kept, you can modify my downloaded file. Although, it is far more likely you'd want every item to be kept. In which case, you have no need for this addon.

Keep Some Inventory uses an exclusion list to decide which items will be dropped on player death. This means any new items added to your game will not automatically be dropped on death. Rather, they will be kept. As such, addons can be used to extend this exclusion list without modifying the source (Keep Some Inventory). These addons are in data pack format.

This addon is compatible with both the data pack version and the modded version of Keep Some Inventory's release.
